scenario.basis: Researcher-defined proxy, not an actual family stay or participant test

family_decision: Does the named six-capacity duplex provide evidence-supported sleeping and midday-rest separation for this party, rather than only a capacity label and dated price?
hypothesis: Inspected two-bedroom family reviews establish six-person sofa use and dependable midday rest.

tripcom.limits: Hosting labels reviews verified; not independently established here. Selected body reports, not all reviews or a representative distribution. Management replies and numeric scores excluded.

tripadvisor.limits: Opened body differs from search-exposed newer material; accept only inspected metadata. A historical general stair tip is not an exact-category field observation. AI summary, selected five-bubble highlights, scores and management replies excluded.

official-category.limits: Gallery/navigation body lacks category capacity, duplex and feature text. HTTP/body access is not revalidation; October3 native category facts and prices are not renewed. No repeat browser/booking attempt or access workaround.

method.selection: Two directly inspected named Two Bedrooms Apartment family reports, one smaller-category family sleep conflict, one historical general stair tip. Purposeful task sample, not random or representative.
method.accepted_surface: Opened source body and displayed metadata, not search snippet, author profile, management reply or generated platform summary.
method.privacy: Public-safe short paraphrases only; no names, profile links, copied review passages or numeric ratings retained.
method.date_basis: Collection date differs from displayed review publication and stay month; exact stay days unavailable. No exact retrieval timestamp was captured.
method.source_searches: Qualitative London-six/hotel/apartment discovery and Citadines review search; no controlled US ranking, demand or representative SERP overlap result.
method.access: Ordinary public web reader on newly selected Citadines review sources; no account, contact, booking, paid call, denied-source retry or alternate-tool/origin bypass. Earlier Tate/competitor/other-provider holds remain untouched.

signals.paraphrase: A family report praises the location and room comfort; occupancy, sofa use and rest timing are unspecified.
An older family theatre-trip report values location and service while distinguishing the finish from more polished accommodation.
A four-person family report liked cooking facilities but described dishwasher upkeep problems and persistent night noise.
A historical solo report mentions a spiral stair between living space and bedrooms, with luggage difficulty.

excluded.reason: Newer two-storey family complaint and newer photo captions absent from opened body; not accepted or merged into the signal set. Search/opened-body date and content mismatch is preserved, not resolved by another domain or browser.

excluded.surface: Tripadvisor generated summary and positive highlights
excluded.reason: Generated/curated aggregate is not an independently sampled guest corpus or an additional report.
Provider assertions are not guest corroboration or verified changes to physical layout, repairs or service.
Mixed roles and result geography do not establish distinct six-person material demand or current US paired-SERP ownership. No competitor facts or community identities copied.

budget_boundary: Retain own October3 public GBP527.20/585.20 per whole apartment/night equivalents for two adults and children4/8/12/15, November8-13 five nights, with original plans/stay totals/tax-fee/deposit/age and sofa unknowns. This audit does not renew, calculate a complete group cost or treat review value opinions as price evidence.

result.decision: CANDIDATE with limited Citadines category-linked review evidence now collected; PRESERVE public URLs and exact-six sofa/rest claims as unknown.
result.finding: Named-category positive reports do not identify six occupants or sofa use. The smaller-category sleep conflict and historical stair tip qualify verification questions, not a quietness or accessibility verdict.
result.confidence: High source/category/date distinctions; low representativeness and current-category applicability; unknown actual family rest, satisfaction and SEO effects.
result.reusable_lesson: A family label or positive room adjective cannot establish the requested occupancy, sleeping allocation or rest timing. Current search snippets also cannot renew older opened-body evidence.
result.next_gate: Current exact-category layout/sofa-use/entrance evidence or explicitly unknown claim-limited public scope; independent current paired-US intent/materiality/noexistingfit and bounded corpus maintenance. Metropole exact-age prices/Bridge flexible eligibility/extras remain separate.014 delegates dated city selection, not facts or launch readiness.
result.next_eligible_action: Qualify a bounded London comparison owner and maintainable public claim set against current material-job evidence, retaining entrance/rest unknowns unless permitted evidence resolves them; do not repeat this selected sample or unchanged denied sources.
result.falsification_trigger: A readable newer named-category report identifies actual six occupants and sofa/rest use, verified category layout changes, or current job/competition evidence supports or rejects a bounded comparison.

release_scope: Seven docs/test/ledger/operator paths only; no public consumer or browser/desktop/mobile/keyboard delivery claim. All original room/price/review records and public assets immutable. Native focused/full/different read-only review then exact guarded docs/test push required; no Pages wait.
